June 3, 1942.

Memo. No. B. 32.

To C.C.R. for teleprinter

Officer i/c Central Station,
" " Louza Station,
" " Sinza Station,
" " Chengtu Road Station.

Reference to Anti-British and Anti-American Association
meeting scheduled for 1 p.m. to-day, the meeting will be held
in the Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association, 480 Yu Ya Ching
Road, in case of heavy rain. The procession will start about
3 p.m. and the route is unchanged. It will disperse inside
the Race Course.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER (DIVISIONS) JUN 3 1942）

Officer i/c Chinese Affairs,
Special Branch.

pages.en:
January 27, 1942.

A. C. (Special Branch)

Censorship of Newspapers

The Japanese Authorities desire that the
S.M.P. continue to censor all foreign and Chinese
newspapers, excepting those that are censored by
the Press Bureau.

In this connection, I suggest that D. S.I.
Nancarrow submit proposals to improve the censorship
work and which will also create good understanding
between the two censoring bodies.

P.A.to D.C. F.B.II (Cr.& Spl.Br.)
pages.zh:
1942年1月27日。

助理警务处长（特别处）

报纸审查

日本当局希望上海公共租界工部局警务处继续对所有外文及中文报纸进行审查，但由新闻检查局审查的报纸除外。

就此事宜，我建议副总巡南卡罗提交改进审查工作的提案，此举亦将促进两个审查机构之间的良好谅解。

第二副警务处长（刑事及特别处）私人助理

pages.en:
January 16,1942.

A. C. (Special Branch)

I have been informed by the Japanese Authorities
that the figures compiled by the Special Branch regarding
the arrival and departures by vessel are incorrect.

On this account, I suggest that the detectives
making these enquiries be temporarily attached to this
office to perform the same duty under my supervision
until such time when the matter is smoothed up.

P. A. to D.C. F.B.II(Cr.& Sp. Br.)
pages.zh:
1942年1月16日。

助理警务处长（特别处）

我已从日本当局处获悉，特别处编制的关于船舶抵离人数的数据有误。

鉴于此，我建议将负责此类调查的侦探暂时调至本办公室，在我的监督下履行相同职责，直至此事得到妥善解决。

第二副警务处长（刑事及特别处）私人助理

pages.en:
January 9, 1942.

A. C. (Special Branch)

It has been brought to my notice that there is a
great divergence in the figures compiled by Special
Branch regarding arrivals and departures by railways
as compared with those given me by the Japanese Military
Authorities.

Arrangements have now been concluded by me with
the Japanese Authorities whereby the latter will
supply us daily with the correct figures about the
arrivals and departures by rail. In this connection,
I suggest that a Chinese detective be detailed to collect
the information.

P.A. to D.C. F.B.II(Cr. &Spl.Br.)
pages.zh:
1942年1月9日。

助理警务处长（特别处）

我注意到，特别处编制的关于铁路抵离人数的数据，与日本军方当局提供给我的数据存在巨大差异。

我已与日本当局达成安排，由后者每日向我们提供准确的铁路抵离人数数据。就此事宜，我建议指派一名华籍侦探负责收集该信息。

第二副警务处长（刑事及特别处）私人助理

pages.en:
January 7, 1942.

A. C. (Special Branch)

The Press Bureau of the Japanese Expeditionary Forces
in Central China has granted permission to the Reuters
News Agency to issue its news bulletins to local Press.

In this connection, the Bureau desires that the
Municipal Police instruct its censors to pay great
attention to the headings and contents of all Reuters
messages.

P.A. to D.C. F.B.II(Cr. & Spl.Br.)
pages.zh:
1942年1月7日。

助理警务处长（特别处）

华中日军派遣军新闻检查局已许可路透社向本地报业发布其新闻简报。

就此事宜，该局希望工部局警务处指令其审查员密切关注所有路透社消息的标题和内容。

第二副警务处长（刑事及特别处）私人助理

pages.en:
January 6, 1942.

A. C. (Special Branch).

The closure of five leading book stores in the
Settlement by the Japanese Authorities is bound to bring
about changes in the use of text books by the various
local schools. For this reason, it is suggested that
immediate enquiries be made into the kind of text books
at present being used by the schools located in the "A"
and "B" Divisions.

P.A. to D.C. F.B.II(Cr. &Spl. Br.)
pages.zh:
1942年1月6日。

助理警务处长（特别处）。

日本当局关闭租界内五家主要书店，势必导致当地各学校在使用教科书方面发生变化。因此，建议立即对位于“A”区和“B”区的学校目前使用的教科书种类进行调查。

第二副警务处长（刑事及特别处）私人助理

pages.en:
December 22, 1941.

A. C. ( Special Branch)

I have been directed by Major Goto to ask for an
explanation as to how the article on the opening of
local Courts, as per attached cutting, came to appear
in the Shanghai Sunday Times of 21/12/41.

It is to noted that D.S.I. Nancarrow was
approached on December 19 to inform all newspapers not to
publish articles of - this nature, and further on
December 20 D.S.I. Young, the duty officer, was
acquainted with this instruction.

Major Goto also desires if you will ascertain
from the Shanghai Times as to the source of the said report.

P.A. to D.C. F.B.II (Cr. & Sp. Br.)
pages.zh:
1941年12月22日。

助理警务处长（特别处）

后藤大佐指示我询问，为何关于地方法院开庭的文章（见附件剪报）会出现在1941年12月21日的《上海星期泰晤士报》上。

需注意，已于12月19日接洽副总巡南卡罗，告知其通知所有报纸不得刊登此类文章，此外，值班警官杨副总巡也于12月20日获知此指令。

后藤大佐还希望你向《上海泰晤士报》查明上述报道的来源。

第二副警务处长（刑事及特别处）私人助理
